_note: Curated starter dataset written by hand. Hours, fees and timings are NOT included on purpose; verify locally before visiting.

places.name: Shaniwar Wada
places.note: 18th-century Peshwa-era fortified palace complex.

places.name: Aga Khan Palace
places.note: Palace linked to the Indian independence movement.

places.name: Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple
places.note: Well-known Ganesh temple, busiest during Ganesh festival.

places.name: Parvati Hill
places.note: Hill with temples and a city view, reached by steps.

places.name: Sinhagad Fort
places.note: Hill fort with trekking access, plan a half day.

places.name: Gateway of India
places.note: Waterfront arch monument; ferries to Elephanta leave nearby.

places.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
places.note: Victorian Gothic railway station, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: Marine Drive
places.note: Seafront promenade, popular at sunset.

places.name: Elephanta Caves
places.note: Rock-cut cave temples on an island, reached by ferry.

places.name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park (Kanheri Caves)
places.note: Forest park containing ancient Buddhist caves.

places.name: Trimbakeshwar Temple
places.note: Ancient Shiva temple near the source of the Godavari.

places.name: Ramkund and Panchavati
places.note: Sacred Godavari ghat area tied to the Ramayana.

places.name: Pandavleni Caves
places.note: Ancient Buddhist cave group on a hill, involves steps.

places.name: Nashik vineyards
places.note: Winery visits and tastings, Nashik is a known wine region.

places.name: Deekshabhoomi
places.note: Stupa where Dr. B. R. Ambedkar embraced Buddhism.

places.name: Sitabuldi Fort
places.note: Historic hill fort in the city centre.

places.name: Mahalaxmi (Ambabai) Temple
places.note: Major temple of the goddess Mahalaxmi.

places.name: New Palace (Chhatrapati Shahu Museum)
places.note: Royal palace housing a museum.

places.name: Ajanta Caves
places.note: UNESCO World Heritage Buddhist cave paintings; a full-day trip.

places.name: Ellora Caves
places.note: UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut temples including the Kailasa temple.

places.name: Bibi Ka Maqbara
places.note: 17th-century mausoleum often called the Taj of the Deccan.
